content.short: A community-driven project that features a futuristic cyberpunk theme with many utilities offered such as virtual world, deflationary mechanism and more.
content.description:
With the current state of web2 services (social media/streaming services/applications) adopting blockchain technology to further increase the immersion when one gets into social media, big corporations such as Adidas, Nike, LV, Gucci partnered up with various NFT brands in this movement. The team behind Project 2090 noticed how mass adoption in the Metaverse starts with clothing brands and most important component in the Metaverse are 𝗜𝗗𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗜𝗧𝗜𝗘𝗦 and a large part of one's physical identity is determined by fashion.

With a team of artistic people from various artistic/streetwear culture Project 2090 was started as a means to provide identities to holders. With that being said, our artists spend a lot of time in crafting the Cyborg NFTs, carefully fixing all impurities found in the drawings. We plan to collaborate/build on the most promising Cardano Metaverse project to deploy our virtual world. The Project 2090 themed virtual world will feature a Cyberpunk setting to fit with our lore.

Project 2090 will provide the highest grade of avatars and cosmetics, hand crafted services, and authentic community experiences to aid with involvement in the Metaverse.

If you’re into NFTs, I believe we share the same vision.
